global_blocker.closure_role: contract-hardening-and-evidence; not a new blocker decision

included: committed support and lifecycle-policy contract hooks
excluded_decisions: mutable rootStore or duplicate global coeffect cache
new state carrier or observation boundary
scope.compile_harness_mode: standalone mirror of the accepted ADR-03 carrier; do not import beside a production module that redeclares CordisADR03 names

well_formedness.note: ParentRooted and DeclarationConsistency are supplied at the boundary; they are not silently selected here.

provider.active_providers: { n : IncarnationId // ProvidesNow policy s.registry n k }
provider.active_binding: provider ID plus value, provider witness, and global lookup witness
provider.choice_spec: CoreWellFormed policy s implies (providerOf policy s k = some n iff ProvidesNow policy s.registry n k)
provider.uniqueness_spec: under CoreWellFormed policy s, two ProvidesNow witnesses for one key imply equal incarnation IDs

aggregation.store_disjoint: forall k, k in sigma -> k in tau -> False
aggregation.checked_merge: some (sigma union tau) on disjointness, none on overlap
aggregation.fold_contract: activeUnionAux is invariant under permutation of the registry-key traversal

static_update.checked_modify: Option RawState; succeeds only when the static projection is preserved

lifecycle_and_committed.policy_soundness_hook: providesNow life = true iff IsActive life
lifecycle_and_committed.committed_support_closed: every committed-view key is present in the named provider localStore

frames_and_observation.local_store_frame: provider localStore remains unchanged across a guarded interval
frames_and_observation.tracked_context: state plus accumulator, with coeffect equal to activeUnion of state
frames_and_observation.observation_boundary: ADR-03 CoreStateObs and ADR-01/02 relations unchanged

contracts.theorem_hypothesis_discipline: Expose acyclicity explicitly in theorem signatures where required; do not rely on an implicit WellFormed premise as a substitute.
